    The separation criterion at a minimal point #

    The dual of sepComp_of_coboundary, via the opposite category: if c is minimal in a set D on which every cocycle is a coboundary, two arrows out of c whose targets are joined inside D \ {c} lie in one component of the prefix order on nonzero morphisms out of c with targets in D \ {c} (outComp_of_coboundary).
